validity.recommendation: Keep as-is; fill endpoints (EWPS-1 -> Shedgum, Eastern Province). Note the per-line 28 km / $46M figures are a 50/50 split of the combined package-3 total (56 km / ~$92M covering BOTH loops 3 and 4) - verify the split is intended, not a double-count with P6718.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE (high, real): This is loop line 3 (EWGP-3) of Aramco's Master Gas System expansion phase 3 (MGS-3), corridor EWPS-1 to Shedgum. Three independent sources name it: MEED (trade press) - 'Laying 56-inch east-west gas pipelines three and four from EWPS-1 to Shedgum, covering 56 kilometres,' awarded to Gas Arabian (package 3); Zawya (reporting Tadawul-listed Gas Arabian Services' own contract disclosure) - 'Master Gas System expansion from SHEDGUM to EWPS-1,' SAR 344,614,412 (~$92M), 40-month duration; Blackridge Research - 'Package 3 ... 56-inch diameter pipelines (EWGP-3 and EWGP-4) from EWPS-1 to Shedgum (56km),' Gas Arabian, under construction. Not GEM-derived. CLASSIFICATION (correct): gas transmission trunk (Master Gas System sales-gas network) - PipelineType=transmission and Fuel=Gas are right. DUPLICATE (checked, NOT a duplicate): P6717 = loop '3' = EWGP-3; P6718 = loop '4' = EWGP-4 - two PHYSICALLY PARALLEL loop lines on the same EWPS-1->Shedgum corridor, a standard Aramco looping pattern, so they are distinct pipes rather than one relabeled twice. CAVEAT: the sources give a COMBINED figure for the pair - 56 km of pipe and one ~$91.89M/$92M package covering both loops 3 AND 4. GEM has split this 50/50: 28 km and $46M on each of P6717/P6718. That reconciles arithmetically (28+28=56 km; 46+46=~92M) and parallel loops are typically co-length, so this is a reasonable interpretation - but the 28 km/$46M per-line values are inferred from a package total, not independently stated per line. ATTRIBUTION: Owner Aramco 100% correct (Aramco owns the MGS); endpoints EWPS-1 (start) and Shedgum (end), both Eastern Province - currently blank in the sheet, staged as a fill. SPEC: diameter 56 in (all three sources); length 28 km and SegmentCost $46M both = combined-package total / 2; StartYear1 2028 matches the Q4-2028 completion target (Blackridge). All corroborated at >=2 independent sources.

fills.researcher_notes: Endpoints were blank except country. Both sources explicitly name the EWPS-1 -> Shedgum corridor. Shedgum is Aramco's gas plant in Eastern Province; EWPS-1 is the first station on the East-West gas corridor in the same Eastern-Province area (Abqaiq/Shedgum vicinity). Capacity left blank - no per-line capacity is disclosed by any source (MGS-3 adds 3.2 bscfd network-wide but not attributed per segment); not fabricating.
